Title:

Data Engineer, JR

KBR is seeking a Data Engineer to support one of our government customers in Reston, Virginia. The Data Engineer utilizes a diverse range of data-focused skills, experience, deep technical and analytical problem solving, and team-centered solutioning for complex problems to satisfy priority information enabling operations. This position requires strong attributes for problem solving, data analysis, troubleshooting, analytical thinking, and experimentation, often under time sensitive decisions.
Data Engineer, Jr Key Requirements 
The Junior Data Engineer provides Systems Engineering and Technical Assistance (SETA) support to our government customer.
Support the collection, integration, validation, maintenance, and analysis of mission-relevant data used to inform space and counterspace intelligence operations.
Develop and maintains data workflows, automation solutions, and reporting products that enable efficient management of large and diverse datasets.
The data Engineer works with government personnel, mission partners, and technical teams to ensure data quality, accessibility, and operational effectiveness.
Contribute to mission planning, collection management, and data-driven analysis in support of national security objectives.
Roles and Responsibilities
Support the collection, processing, validation, and maintenance of large datasets used in space and counterspace mission activities.
Develop and maintain automated workflows, scripts, and processes to collect, transform, integrate, and manage data from multiple sources.
Analyze RF, signals, collection, and other technical data to identify patterns, trends, and mission-relevant insights.
Assist in integrating disparate datasets and establishing data quality standards, governance practices, and data management procedures.
Testing and validation of dashboards, reports, visualizations, and other data products that support operational analysis and decision-making.
Support collection management activities by tracking requirements, monitoring tasking, and aligning data efforts with mission priorities.
Maintain databases, data repositories, and associated documentation to ensure accuracy, accessibility, and compliance with program requirements.
Provide technical support for mission planning, operational reporting, and readiness assessment activities.
Collaborate with government stakeholders and mission partners to support data-driven initiatives and operational objectives.

Required Qualifications: 

Degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics (STEM), Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
0 to 5 years of experience in data engineering, data analysis, intelligence operations, collection management, RF analysis, or a related technical field.
Experience managing, validating, maintaining, or analyzing large datasets in operational, intelligence, or mission-focused environments.
Experience with data analysis, scripting, and database technologies, including Python, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent tools.
Active Top-Secret/SCI clearance with Poly
Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting Department of Defense, Intelligence Community, or other government operational missions.
Knowledge of RF collection systems, signals analysis methodologies, collection management processes, or mission planning activities.

Basic Compensation:

95,200 - $119,000

This range is for the Virginia area only.

The offered rate will be based on the selected candidate’s knowledge, skills, abilities, and/or experience and in consideration of internal parity.

Additional Compensation:

KBR may offer bonuses, commissions, or other forms of compensation to certain job titles or levels per internal policy or contractual designation. Additional compensation may be in the form of a sign-on bonus, relocation benefits, short-term incentives, long-term incentives, or discretionary payments for exceptional performance

About Us

Trinzic is the future independent company to be created through the planned spin-off of KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business, expected in January 2027. Our people work at the frontier of what is possible, delivering solutions in challenging environments and advancing some of the world's highest-priority national security and space missions. 
 
Backed by decades of mission success, deep expertise, and trusted partnerships, Trinzic will launch as a global organization with more than 18,000 employees supporting customers around the world. Join us at a defining moment and help shape the future of a company built to tackle complex challenges and make a meaningful impact

Fraud Alert 
 
As Trinzic prepares to launch as an independent company through the planned spin-off of KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business, job seekers may encounter fraudulent recruiting activity that improperly uses the names, logos, or branding of either Trinzic or KBR. 
Bad actors may mix in fake job advertisements with legitimate postings. These ads can include contact instructions and require job seekers to send sensitive personal information or money to pay for visa applications, processing fees, etc., in exchange for consideration for a high-paying position.  
  
Neither Trinzic nor KBR will ever ask for any sort of advance payment as part of the recruiting or hiring process. Candidate profiles are carefully managed to protect personal information.  If you experience fraud in a job offer, we encourage you to contact the KBR ethics hotline (fhoukbrcode@kbr.com) and report it to the Federal Trade Commission by clicking here.
